summary.text: Lady Poison Scorpion is rank seven Gu Immortal Zi Yan Ran, named as the owner of Zi Du blessed land in the deepest part of the poisonous grassland.

claims.text: An uncountable number of poisonous grass grows on her blessed land, with many large poisonous swamps and marshes and large amounts of poisonous beasts and poisonous Gu. Their toxins accumulate until even the blessed land cannot endure them, so every few years its entrance opens and releases dense toxic gas that mostly becomes the purple poison fog of the poisonous grassland. Creatures from the lowest rung also sneak out during those openings, including large numbers of poison beard wolves. After that long cycle, dark clouds cover the surroundings all year, purple fog lingers, poisonous grass grows, and mortals name the forbidden zone the poisonous grassland out of fear. Fang Yuan seeks snow spirea in those depths, where dense poisonous fog encourages its growth.

Gui Wang, finding the snow spirea’s snow wash Gu already taken and no Immortal Gu aura left, guesses that the rank seven Gu Immortal Lady Poison Scorpion in Zi Du blessed land took it into her aperture. He would rather believe that than that the Gu died. He can gather the Hua Hai three immortals and Loner Hong Yu to attack Lang Ya blessed land for promised benefits, but lacks bargaining chips to make them attack Zi Du blessed land as well. Seeing that Zi Du blessed land is about to open its doors and expel poisonous gas, he leaves rather than face her.

Fang Yuan recalls that Dream Travel is in the hands of the Northern Plains Gu Immortal Lady Poison Scorpion, who lies dormant in Zi Du blessed land. She is the first Gu Immortal who used Dream Travel to explore dream realms, and in the future she uses a lone cultivator identity to become the third overlord of dream realms. He calls her a rank seven Gu Immortal with battle strength greater than Hei Cheng, and the defense of her blessed land like an iron fortress that is not easy to target.

Fang Yuan names two dream path Immortal Gu he knows of in this life: one with mortal Feng Jin Huang, the other with Lady Poison Scorpion. He finds the latter more problematic because she is in her blessed land, slumbering as she explores a dream realm.

From five hundred years of memories, Fang Yuan knows Dream Travel was in Lady Poison Scorpion’s hands. In those memories it is one of the four publicly recognized great movement Immortal Gu with Carefree Travel, Fixed Immortal Travel, and Liquor God Travel, and with it she could travel through dreams and instantly enter any single dream realm. He had little confidence in targeting her for that reason. Among dream path geniuses in those memories he ranks shocking talents like Feng Jin Huang and Lady Poison Scorpion, and names both as Great Dream Immortal Venerable seeds.

Fang Yuan judges that even if Lady Poison Scorpion is a Gu Immortal, she was not an immortal ascended from the Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique and cannot compare with him on that point. He also groups Northern Plains’ Lady Poison Scorpion with Western Desert’s Tang clan and Central Continent’s Feng Jin Huang as parties who would use dream realms to stay ahead of the era.
